findings.text: the file-existence check this module promises is unreachable for the value that triggers it: parse_manifest turns the exact scalar changed_paths: none (or nil) into [], so the guard returns at its not-manifest.get(changed_paths) clause before _changed_paths_declare_no_paths (:1885) ever reaches _first_changed_path_is_a_file (:1757), whose docstring says a run that really changed a file called none or nil keeps the path and the run keeps the commit it names; four crew.complete arms over a repository that really changed a file named none, nil, n/a or -, with manifest changed_paths: <name> and commits: none, each promoted with no commit (DID NOT RAISE).

the command receipt names only tests/test_a_discard_never_reads_promoted.py and lets the remaining files follow as bare continuation lines, while the reviewed manifest's tests line (manifest.md:10) carries an angle-bracket placeholder around the same list (25 tests/test_*promot*.py + tests/test_cited_identifier_resolves.py), so the runnable command behind the recorded 249-passed gate is not reconstructible from either record.
